name: hotfix_2026_11_25_part1
objective: Full notes: official Blizzard hotfix post, linked in the description.
pages: Improved Wrath is now Starlight Wrath. It also cuts Starfire's cast time by 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 or 0.5 seconds, by rank.
Improved Moonfire is now Moon and Stars. It gives Starfire a 50 or 100% chance not to lose cast time when you take damage.
Cut from 5 points to 2: an 8% or 15% chance. Druids with 3 or more points in it get all talent points reset.
Eclipse now also raises Wrath's critical strike chance by 7, 13 or 20% at all times.
Moonfury is gone. Dreamstate gives you 20 to 100% of Innervate's benefit when you cast Innervate on someone else.
Moonkin Form now also raises your Arcane and Nature damage by 10% while it is active.
Hurricane's final hit now lands correctly.
Genesis now boosts Hurricane's damage and Tranquility's healing.
Pets had 0% critical strike chance on their basic melee attacks. That is fixed.
Summoned Hawks attack the target you summon them on, even if your pet is set to Passive.
Hawks leave when Dismiss Pet finishes, or when you right-click their icon below your portrait.
Hawks attack your current target if they are not already attacking something.
Hawks had about 5% less critical strike chance than intended.
Judgements on enemies now refresh from your attacks when they have less than 20 seconds left.
Oath of Light now lasts 60 minutes.
All Rogue Poisons and Blinding Powder are bind-on-pickup for now, while Blizzard fixes a bug.
Poised is now removed when you cast Sap or Distract from Stealth.
Chain Lightning now uses up Clearcasting when you have both Clearcasting and 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Pets had 0% critical strike chance on basic melee attacks.
They had 5% more critical strike chance than intended.
Weaponmaster now reapplies after you die in Battlegrounds.
